messages:
Grace (Sales): FYI Verdant Analytics reports they were charged the standard rate on INV-2026-0301 despite a negotiated 30% discount recorded in their contract. They sent the signed amendment. https://console.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0301

Marta (BillingOps): Pulling invoice... INV-2026-0301 total: $18,200. No promo/discount lines present. Contract system shows discount token DISC-VERD30 active from 2026-07-01.

BillingBot (system): Audit log:
- Contract amendment AMND-667 attached at 2026-07-02 11:12 UTC
- Discount token DISC-VERD30 created 2026-07-02 11:15 UTC
- Billing run for period: 2026-07-31 02:00 UTC
- Note: discount token not picked up during billing run due to mapping gap (reason: customer_id mismatch: contract linked to VD-77, billing uses VD-077)

Neil (Finance): Because of the ID mismatch the discount engine skipped the account. Recommend manual credit to honor the negotiated 30%. Calculation: 30% of $18,200 = $5,460. Post under GL-4120 (Customer discounts). Approve?

Grace (Sales): Yes please. Sales confirms contract and will handle internal QA to ensure IDs match. We want the customer-facing credit and a short explanation.

Marta (BillingOps): Proposed ledger command:
redwood-bill adjust --cust VD-077 --invoice INV-2026-0301 --amount -5460 --type credit --gl GL-4120 --note "Honor negotiated 30% discount per AMND-667; contract ID mapping fix pending"

BillingBot (system): Simulation: New invoice total after -$5,460 credit = $12,740. Adjustment will create ADJ-35688. Recommendation: also create PROD task to reconcile contract->billing id mapping (PROD-9011).

Neil (Finance): Approved. Please execute and attach ADJ ID + updated PDF to case FIN-2026-211. Open ACCT ticket ACCT-8010 for month-end posting.

Marta (BillingOps): Executing now (ops user).

BillingBot (system): Adjustment executed at 1778000600. Adjustment ID ADJ-35688. Updated invoice: https://console.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0301/adjusted/ADJ-35688.pdf. Journal entry queued GL-4120.

Grace (Sales): Customer notified with apology and confirmation of applied 30% discount. Sales to follow up on mapping fix.

Neil (Finance): Confirmed ACCT-8010 created. Closing from finance after posting. Thanks everyone.
